data.exact_reserve_text: Overall on an aggregate basis, reserve releases of GBP 0.8m net of reinsurance were made to prior year reserves during 2017. In 2016 there was a reserve release of GBP 1.4m.

named_events.loss_description: 2017 was a year marked by an exceptional series of large natural catastrophe losses including Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria (HIM) in the U.S. and the Caribbean. These catastrophe losses were compounded by a high frequency of large losses during 2017 but despite this elevated level of activity, the property account did benefit from a release of reserves during the financial year.
2017 was a year marked by an exceptional series of large natural catastrophe losses including ... wildfires in California.
We strengthened reserves for two specific large claims on the Financial Institutions part of our Liability account during 2017 following the market wide FCA review into annuity sales.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 the Syndicate had gross claims outstanding of GBP 210.466m. During 2017 cumulative gross ultimate claims movements (per the gross claims development table) produced a net adverse movement of approximately GBP 12.8m (gross strengthening) concentrated in several older underwriting years, while on a net-of-reinsurance basis the Syndicate reported an aggregate net reserve release of GBP 0.8m. The gross strengthening was driven by adverse development in parts of the Liability and Accident & Health portfolios (including two large Financial Institutions liability claims following the FCA annuity review), partially offset by favourable development / releases in the Property, Marine and Credit & Political Risk accounts. Major 2017 natural catastrophe activity (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and California wildfires) influenced current year losses and reinsurance placements but reinsurance recoveries and reserve movements produced mixed impacts across lines.
raw_causal_phrases: 2017 was a year marked by an exceptional series of large natural catastrophe losses including Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria (HIM) in the U.S. and the Caribbean, and wildfires in California.
We strengthened reserves for two specific large claims on the Financial Institutions part of our Liability account during 2017 following the market wide FCA review into annuity sales.
Across all classes combined we had a net reserve release of GBP 0.8m.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross +12.802m) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (cumulative ultimate claims) by comparing current estimates to the previous diagonal for underwriting years up to 2015 (triangle located on page 36). The report explicitly states a net reserve release of GBP 0.8m (net of reinsurance) - the gross strengthening vs net release difference indicates material reinsurer movements. No explicit single-line gross 'movement in prior year provision' figure was provided, so triangle-based calculation was used (confidence 0.8). Lob-level reserve amounts are not quantified in the notes, so LOB movements are directional only and inferred from text.
